Leviathan.text: At the Reaping: If your Alignment did not gain you Glory, gain 1 Glory if any other player loses Glory this Reaping.
Leviathan.why: Pays only when your own Alignment gained nothing (V37 balance)

Tree of Life.text: On your turn: Take the top card of the discard pile into your hand, then discard a card from your hand.
Tree of Life.why: Top card of the discard pile only, was any card (V37 balance)

Envy.text: On your turn: If the player with the most Glory has at least 3 more Glory than you, they lose 1 Glory. Each tied leader loses 1.
Envy.why: Only when the leader is 3 or more Glory ahead of you (V37 balance)

Tribute.text: Other players must pay 1 Glory to the Pot before they may Target any card in your Choir with an ability.
Tribute.why: Payment goes to the Pot, not to you (V37 balance)

Watchers.text: On your turn: Look at the top 3 cards of the Host deck. Put 1 into your hand and discard a card from your hand, then return the rest in any order.
Watchers.why: Keep 1 of the 3, then discard a card (V37 balance)

Forger.text: When you Gather, you may take any Host card from the discard pile instead of a card from the Altar or the deck.
Forger.why: Any card from the discard pile, was the top card (V37 balance)

Apple.text: At the Reaping: If your Choir's Alignment is the opposite color from the previous Day's Tide, gain 1 Glory.
Apple.why: Gain 1 when you lean against yesterday's Tide, was a doubled gain (V37 balance)

Council.text: On your turn: You may replace another card in your Choir with a card from your hand. Then each other player may do the same by paying you 1 Glory. Replaced cards are discarded.
Council.why: No vote; others pay you 1 Glory to join (V37 balance)

Mirage.text: Your facedown Offerings cannot be flipped, looked at, exchanged, or destroyed before the Evening. When the Altar is revealed, if any of your facedown Offerings is still on it, draw 1 card.
Mirage.why: Adds a card draw when your facedown Offering survives to the reveal (V37 balance)
